defect.source: Phase 7.14 independent acceptance report, section 84, non-blocking observation 1
defect.symptom: A failed Stop told the owner 'The toolkit could not be started.'
defect.root_cause: _owner_message() selected text from the readiness state alone, and SESSION7_14_LAUNCHER_FAILED is shared by the start path (CONSOLE_SPAWN_FAILED, CONSOLE_EXITED_DURING_STARTUP) and the stop path (CONSOLE_DID_NOT_STOP).
defect.secondary: All three SESSION7_14_LAUNCHER_STOP_REFUSED outcomes shared one sentence asserting the process 'is not the console this launcher started', which is wrong for PROCESS_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN where the launcher cannot prove the identity either way.

fix.mechanism: stop-path owner text selected by canonical error_code, scoped to phase="stop"

wording.CONSOLE_DID_NOT_STOP: The toolkit did not stop within the allowed time. Nothing else on this computer was stopped. See the launcher log for the recorded reason.
wording.PROCESS_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: The toolkit was not stopped because the launcher could not safely verify the process identity. Nothing on this computer was stopped.
wording.PID_REUSED_BY_ANOTHER_PROCESS: The process was not stopped because it was not started by this launcher. The recorded process number now belongs to a different program, so nothing was stopped.
wording.NOT_LAUNCHER_OWNED: The process was not stopped because it was not started by this launcher. A console is answering on this port, but this launcher did not start it, so nothing was stopped.
wording.generic_stop_failure: The toolkit could not be stopped. See the launcher log for the recorded reason.

stop_never.note: true means the launcher never does this; asserted by tests h10, h10b, h10c, h11, h11b and the accepted suite's tests 037, 037b, 037c

process_alive_windows_handle_sensitivity.reason: The shipped launcher runs one command per process, where the condition does not arise. The independent auditor classified it non-blocking.

start_no_browser_ready_message.reason: start --no-browser still prints 'Your browser should now be open on the console.' The flag is a diagnostic switch the owner wrappers never pass, so no owner sees it.

baseline_run.method: new test file copied into a fresh b3e357e worktree and run there, then the worktree restored with git checkout --

runs.owner_message: The toolkit was not running, so there was nothing to stop.
The toolkit is not running yet. Run Start-AMZ-Toolkit first.
The process was not stopped because it was not started by this launcher. A console is answering on this port, but this launcher did not start it, so nothing was stopped.

separate_process_start_stop.why: Windows process_alive() is handle-sensitive, so stop can only be judged honestly across separate processes

unrelated_process_refusal_end_to_end.setup: console started outside the launcher on 127.0.0.1:8780, pid 8452
unrelated_process_refusal_end_to_end.owner_message: The process was not stopped because it was not started by this launcher. A console is answering on this port, but this launcher did not start it, so nothing was stopped.

non_passing_accounted_for.explanation: Pre-acceptance self-guard asserting no Phase 7.14 acceptance tag exists. It passed at implementation time and fails now because the independent audit created that very tag. Fails identically on the untouched baseline worktree.
non_passing_accounted_for.disposition: retire or re-scope in the next Phase 7.14-touching change; out of scope here

non_passing_accounted_for.explanation: Windows loopback race: the 7.13 console closes the connection after rejecting an oversized request body and the client sometimes observes the abort before reading the response. Same WinError 10053 signature the Phase 7.14 audit recorded as a known environment flake.

fresh_worktree_differential.method: two fresh worktrees run concurrently with each other and nothing else, full discovery and full output captured on both sides
fresh_worktree_differential.why_nonzero: runs/T2 is gitignored, so the 14 errors are T2-data-dependent tests that cannot find their inputs in a bare checkout; the differential is judged relatively, not absolutely

source_sha256.note: both files are pinned text eol=lf in .gitattributes, so these values reproduce in any checkout regardless of core.autocrlf; verified identical between the fresh worktree and the working copy

source_immutability.verified_by: git diff --stat b3e357e HEAD reports exactly 2 files

recommendation: Independent hotfix acceptance audit before merge or pilot. Suggested focus: the canonical readiness/error-code contract is unchanged; stop gained no aggression; Start and Open wording is provably untouched; and the 13 control tests genuinely pass on both sides.
